'''Michael Josem Good deck''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Michael Josem]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-6885">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/6885 Good deck], DeckTech (Michael "Joz" Josem, 19 May 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/6885/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/6885/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018173005/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/6885/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

* '''Player:''' [[Michael Josem]]
* '''Published:''' 19 May 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Good deck''

* '''Strategy:''' Really good deck.

== Original post ==

'''Good deck'''
* '''Author:''' Michael "Joz" Josem
* '''Published:''' May 19, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 3.5
* '''Description:''' Really good deck.

=== Strategy ===

Start Insurrection

Activate force

Get docking bays and dag sites out

Deploy DTF/Beggar

Deploy Dudes

Fight

Play destiny adders

Win
